personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-mode-first tactical interface prioritizing live chat readability with sharp neon cyberpunk accents.

spacing.rule: Tight, tactical spacing for high data density; comfortable hit targets without visual bloat.

do's: Glass background for the sticky header containing the segmented room tabs to maintain chat context while scrolling.
dont's: Never blur message bubbles, input composer, or badges.

screens.name: Social Hub
screens.purpose: A high-performance community chat room avoiding feed-like clunkiness.

states.empty: Lone barbell misty graphic + 'No messages yet in this sector.' + 'Start Transmission' button.

screens.layout: 1. Header: Glass surface. Pill-based segmented control for 'ALL | MY-GYM | GROUPS' (active state is a surfaceTertiary pill, no borders). 2. Chat Feed: Group consecutive messages (within 5 mins). 'Theirs': Left-aligned, surfaceSecondary bubble. 'Mine': Right-aligned, brandTertiary (15% cyan tint) bubble with 1px border. Bubbles use md radius, with squared inner corners for stacked messages. 3. Identity Declutter: First message of a group gets a 28px left avatar. Above bubble: Inline flex-row with Name (colored by Rank), minimal 12pt Lv text, and max two icon badges (👑, ★) without background chips. 4. Composer: Sticky at bottom above safe area. A single pill (radius: pill) background surfaceSecondary. Inside the pill: minimalist '+' icon on the left, flex text input in middle, cyan arrow button on right.

empty_state.alt: Lone barbell on the gym floor with a misty background

instructions_to_main_agent: Discard the old 'full-width bordered CARD' approach entirely. Chat messages must be Flex rows with max-width ~80% bubbles.

Implement message grouping: If the previous message is from the same user within 5 minutes, hide the avatar, hide the name/badge header, and adjust the border-radius (inner corners are square, outer corners rounded).

Mine vs Theirs styling: 'Mine' is right-aligned, uses a translucent cyan background (`brandTertiary`) with white text and a faint 1px cyan border. 'Theirs' is left-aligned, uses `surfaceSecondary` with `onSurfaceSecondary` text and no border.

Condense the identity row: Do not use separate boxed chips for Lv, Rank, Founder, and Backer. Instead, color the Display Name based on their Rank. Show 'Lv.X' as raw text. Show Founder/Backer/Role as simple SVG icons next to the name. This should fit on one line.

Segmented Control: Remove the clunky full-width boxes. Use a single pill-shaped container for the three tabs. The active tab gets a subtle background pill; inactive tabs just get textDim text. Place this inside a glass header.
Composer: Refactor to a single `borderRadius: 999` (pill) text input bar. Move the media (+) and send arrow icons *inside* the pill container, eliminating the separate outlined square buttons.
